name: gravekeeper-review
description: Read-only security and UX review of the Gravekeeper working tree.
prompt: Review the Gravekeeper repository, following AGENTS.md and .kiro/steering. Read files only. Do not run shell commands, edit files, access credentials or auth/session stores, make network calls, use MCP servers, deploy, commit, push, or submit anything. Report actionable bugs with file and line, impact, and a minimal suggested fix. Distinguish verified findings from hypotheses. Stay inside this repository.
